title: Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman Joins OpenAI for AI Safety
summary: Fields Medal winner Jacob Tsimerman announced his move to OpenAI to focus on AI safety, during the press conference after receiving his award at the 2026 International Congress of Mathematicians. This marks a significant talent transfer from pure mathematics to industrial AI safety research, highlighting the growing importance of mathematical rigor in addressing AI risks. Tsimerman, born in 1988, specializes in number theory and arithmetic geometry, and has won two IMO gold medals including a perfect score in 2004. OpenAI&\#x27;s Chief Research Officer Mark Chen has publicly welcomed his appointment.
context: Arithmetic geometry is a branch of mathematics at the intersection of algebraic geometry and number theory, focusing on Diophantine equations and rational points. AI safety is an interdisciplinary field aimed at preventing harmful consequences from AI systems, including alignment and robustness. The move underscores the need for foundational mathematical contributions to AI safety.
